description: Lists the workspaces of a container. Returns { workspace: [{ workspaceId, name, description, path, fingerprint }], nextPageToken }. Workspaces are mandatory in GTM v2: every tag/trigger/variable operation needs a workspaceId, and a "Default Workspace" always exists — call this first.

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
